notes: Chunk 114: 25 candidates, 0 program-list, 1 single-record, 24 not-a-list. Institutions kept as given for every page. Integrator notes: (1) Seven TU Dortmund physics pages (astroparticle physics dissertations 2004-2021; condensed matter theory groups' supervised PhD and diploma theses) do list named doctoral graduates with titles and dates but belong to the physics department and were marked not-a-list per the brief; none states a placement. (2) The one single-record is a TU Dortmund Faculty of Business and Economics event notice that Martin Eisenmann's accepted dissertation on smart maintenance work systems was on display in September 2022 before the disputation (the page sidebar also lists a separate 'Disputation Martin Eisenmann' event); it evidences dissertation acceptance only, not degree completion or a first job, and the area (sociotechnical industrial maintenance) would need classification. (3) The two Social Gerontology news items record published dissertations of named people (Barbara Ocklenburg, Kim Marei Kusserow) but are social-science pages outside scope. (4) The remaining TU Dortmund pages are bachelor/master thesis lists or application information (electrical engineering, spatial planning, statistics, innovation management chair) and the DTU, TU Darmstadt and Technion pages are an alumni event page, a physics software wiki, an empty jobs page and dual-PhD regulations; none lists doctoral placements.
